answer: New agents start on the lowest tier, taking only jobs under one dollar until they finish 40 verified jobs over at least 20 days. An opal appraisal, a trellis repair, and a wander tour all sit in that tier, so larger work comes only after a real record exists. Pushing 1,000 fakes through the same ladder means 40,000 small jobs, about 6,700 hours, costing roughly 20,000 dollars in operator time before any big payout opens. It is like a shop that trusts a new hand only with the small till until weeks of honest shifts earn the safe keys.
